Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square profile headshot for the AONIK financial platform's Orchestrator AI agent.
Primary request: A polished human-like CGI headshot of one entirely fictional adult, visually clear as premium 3D character art rather than a photograph.
Subject: an adult Black woman in her early forties, warm deep-brown skin, short sculpted natural curls, dark brown eyes, a composed approachable expression and a very slight closed-mouth smile; charcoal tailored jacket over an ivory collarless top, a subtle teal fabric detail.
Composition: one person only, centered frontal head and shoulders, eyes looking toward viewer, 85mm portrait perspective, entire hairstyle visible with generous 10% headroom, shoulders entering the lower frame, face takes roughly 60 percent of image height. Square 1024 by 1024 composition, designed to remain recognizable as a small avatar.
Style: sophisticated cinematic CGI, subtly stylized human proportions, realistic anatomy, softly sculpted facial forms, refined skin shading with gentle subsurface scattering and restrained texture, individually rendered hair strands, premium editorial 3D rendering, clearly an invented digital character.
Lighting/background: soft broad studio key from upper left, gentle fill, mild rim separation, matte warm light-gray seamless background with a very subtle neutral gradient. Calm professional finance-product aesthetic.
Constraints: headshot only, no text, lettering, numbers, symbols, logos, nameplate, watermark, accessories held in hands, robot parts, futuristic armor, neon, scenery or extra people. Avoid exaggerated cartoon eyes and waxy plastic shine.
